text: 前美国总统拜登的国家经济委员会主任布雷纳德（Lael Brainard）向民主党人推介一项低首付方案，旨在将数百万新购房者带入市场；与此同时，即将上任的国会领导人也在评估可能帮助他们取得早期立法成果的住房可负担性措施。 一份提案文本显示，由布雷纳德（曾担任美联储副主席、并在前总统奥巴马任内担任负责国际事务的财政部副部长）领导的一个新政策小组正推动设立一项联邦住房管理局（FHA）计划，为符合“严格承保标准”的首次购房者提供低至1000美元首付的购房便利。FHA将通过提高其收取的保险费用来承担该计划的成本。（彭博）
text_en: Lael Brainard, former director of the National Economic Council under former US President Biden, is pitching Democrats on a low-down-payment plan aimed at bringing millions of new homebuyers into the market; at the same time, incoming congressional leaders are also evaluating housing affordability measures that could help them achieve early legislative results. According to the text of a proposal, a new policy group led by Brainard (a former Fed vice chair and former Treasury undersecretary for international affairs under former President Obama) is pushing to establish a Federal Housing Administration (FHA) program to facilitate home purchases for first-time buyers who meet "strict underwriting standards" with down payments as low as $1,000. The FHA would cover the cost of the program by raising the insurance fees it charges. (Bloomberg)
